name: Daeum Yeogeun Eopseumnida
source:
"Trapped in an endless subway. In this place with no destination and no exit, you must confront the memory you wanted to forget most."

You find yourself trapped in an endless subway after hearing the announcement: “There is no next stop.” Be careful—roaming this subway is a grotesque creature called the “GUEST” that will tear you apart and devour you from head to toe. Your only comfort is that you've encountered mysterious beings known as “Guides.” The Guides tell you that you must discover why you came to this place. Now, everything depends on your choices.

Who will you trust? What will you choose? Can you escape from this eternal nightmare?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4433800/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“被困在无尽的地铁里，在这个没有目的地、没有出口的地方，你必须面对你最想忘记的记忆。”

当你听到“没有下一站”的广播后，你发现自己被困在无尽的地铁里。小心——在地铁里徘徊的是一种被称为“访客”的怪异生物，它会把你撕成碎片，从头到脚吞噬你。你唯一的安慰是你遇到了被称为“向导”的神秘存在。指南告诉你，你必须找出来到这个地方的原因。现在，一切都取决于你的选择。

你会信任谁？你会选择什么？你能逃离这个永恒的噩梦吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4433800/]Steam[/url]]
